get_callbacks: build a list of HuggingFace TrainerCallback instances from a train config and model config
is_slurm_available: check if a SLURM queueing system is available by running the sinfo command
PushToHubRevisionCallback_on_save: push a model checkpoint to a HuggingFace Hub revision and optionally run benchmark jobs on save
DummyConfig: create a lightweight dynamic config object that accepts arbitrary keyword arguments as attributes
CALLBACKS_registry: review the CALLBACKS dictionary that maps callback names to their TrainerCallback class constructors
